phase: First normalized TokenRes profile, step250 stability probe

representation.measurement: 2 fixed dev sequences; per-sequence token variance divided by mean squared raw hidden

interpretation: Correctness tests pass, but normalization alone did not satisfy numerical stability gate. Current evidence shows large MLP branch outputs, strongly attenuated early gradients and near-identical within-sequence late token states. Do not equate RMS threshold failure with NaN or infer that all possible TokenRes designs fail.
next_action: No automatic resubmission, threshold relaxation or architecture/optimizer change; retain evidence and await direction.
